memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; walks unaided around home and hospital.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative); no concerns reported.
falls: No falls in the past 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds (within normal range).
medicines: 5 regular (cetirizine, fluticasone nasal spray, montelukast, alendronate, calcium+vitamin D3); polypharmacy – review against Beers criteria needed.
mood: Reports good mood, denies depression or anxiety.
carers: Mr. Suresh Patel, husband.
goals: "I want to stay active and continue working as a nurse."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fluticasone nasal spray, one spray each nostril OD
montelukast 10 mg HS
alendronate 70 mg once weekly
calcium carbonate 500 mg BD with vitamin D3 400 IU

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Allergy to dust mites: sneezing, nasal congestion, itchy eyes on exposure.

memories.text:

cognition: Mini-Cog score 3/5 (negative).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent; uses a walking stick for outdoor walks due to knee pain.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (negative).
falls: No new falls in past 6 months; gait with stick stable; timed up-and-go 12 seconds (raised fall risk).
medicines: 5 regular; polypharmacy – Beers review completed, no inappropriate meds.
mood: Reports stable mood, denies depression.
carers: Mr. Suresh Patel, husband.
goals: "I want to stay pain‑free and continue part‑time nursing."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: My knees hurt more when it rains; I’ve started using a cane outside and feel steadier.

memories.text:
